exceptions.reason: Jest 30.4.2 still constrains its reporting and coverage paths to minimatch releases that require brace-expansion 1.x/2.x, while GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg is fixed only in brace-expansion 5.0.8.
exceptions.removeWhen: Remove after the supported Jest dependency graph adopts minimatch 10.2.5 or newer and natively resolves brace-expansion 5.0.8 or newer.

exceptions.target: 211 conformance cases reported skipped at baseline
exceptions.reason: The consolidated conformance runner contains intended parity gaps and explicitly skipped vectors that require language-by-language disposition before enforcement can require zero skips.
exceptions.removeWhen: Every conformance skip is implemented or documented as deliberately unsupported with a permanent compatibility decision.

exceptions.target: 60 direct test/it/describe.skip declarations in package tests
exceptions.reason: Package suites contain historical, manual, network-dependent, large-resource, and incomplete cases that need individual review before they can safely be enabled, rewritten, or removed.
exceptions.removeWhen: The manual coverage review assigns and resolves every explicit skip or replaces it with a narrowly documented, continuously reviewed environment-gated test.

exceptions.target: Four passWithNoTests manifests, one no-op test, and one failing placeholder test
exceptions.reason: Several packages can currently report success without discovering tests, while one example package contains the default failing placeholder; the package-contract ratchet keeps each case visible until real coverage exists.
exceptions.removeWhen: Every affected profile has meaningful tests or a permanent documented profile decision, with no passWithNoTests, no-op, or default placeholder command.

exceptions.target: sonar-project.properties and .sonarcloud.properties broad test and generated-file exclusions
exceptions.reason: Legacy Sonar configuration excludes tests broadly and suppresses duplication findings while generated and third-party artifacts are mixed into repository paths; project administration cannot be changed during the current wave.
exceptions.removeWhen: The Sonar backlog wave proves precise source, test, generated, vendored, and coverage boundaries and removes broad exclusions without hiding real findings.
